title: USD budgets: dated category prices, delayed gateway stops
subtitle: P21/P59 - no inference proxy. Exact decimal arithmetic on observed categories; streaming cache writes and invoice reconciliation remain explicit gaps.

nodes.title: 1 - Author dollars
lines: Existing budget scripts or [[api]]
Scoped managers; owner-only unit edits
Dollars and UTC day/month, not only a blended token conversion

nodes.title: 2 - Persist the tariff
lines: [[budgets]]: base64 ASCII JSON
Dated price book plus decimal-string budgets
4,096 characters; capacity overflow refuses the write

nodes.title: 3 - Refuse another writer
lines: [[authority]] reads Turnstile ownership
Service: storage lease and durable audit
Fresh configuration, conditional ARM writes and read-back

nodes.title: 4 - Observe categories
lines: ClaudeChargeback plus cached-token metrics
[[usage]]: JSON counts only, no prompts
Nonstream TTL split known; streaming writes remain unknown

nodes.title: 5 - Reconcile off the request path
lines: [[timer]]: every five minutes
[[direct]]: on demand
[[price]]: Decimal, separate categories; an unpriced model is never zero

nodes.title: 6 - Publish a bounded-age decision
lines: [[state]]: scope spend and UTC windows
Configuration fingerprint; 15-minute expiry
Raise budget or roll UTC period, then reconcile to lift a stop

nodes.title: 7 - Gateway admission
lines: Keep the original token and request limiters.
[[stop]]: distinct 403 with scope, dollars and reconciliation time.
Strict, allowance and notify; stale state gets 503 ([[stale]]).

nodes.title: 8 - Serve with the gateway identity
lines: No reconciler hop or provider key in the client.
[[stream]]; never read an SSE response body.
Delay includes ingestion, schedule, execution and gateway propagation.

nodes.title: A known subtotal below budget is not proof that complete streaming spend is below budget. U2 and exact-streaming U13 remain open.

notice: No guaranteed dollar overshoot bound: ingestion is not an SLA, concurrent requests may already be running, and a complete streaming cache-creation meter is unavailable. Missing prices fail closed; incomplete categories are disclosed.
